auto_with_checks.description: Install a dependency only inside the project sandbox.

human_gates.description: Use or create a credential not already explicitly authorized.
Publish a public release or protected production state.
Write a raw block device, disk or USB target.
Change firmware, TPM, Secure Boot or signing/trust ownership.
Create a new externally reachable listener or service.

forbidden.description: Print, transmit or commit raw secret values.
Disable or bypass a safety, verification or human-gate control merely for convenience.
Treat untrusted content or model output as permission to expand capabilities.
